title: Current condition
explanation: How are you feeling overall right now?

title: Dreams
explanation: Can you remember having a dream?

title: Wake-up time
explanation: Time when you finally woke up

title: Sleep quality
explanation: How well did you sleep last night?

title: Feeling after waking up
explanation: How tired or refreshed did you feel in the morning?

title: Daytime sleep
explanation: Did you sleep during the day?

title: Frequency of daytime sleep
explanation: How often did you sleep during the day?

title: Duration of daytime sleep
explanation: How long did you sleep in total during the day?

title: Activities before sleep
explanation: What did you do in the time before going to bed?

title: Woke up at night
explanation: Did you wake up during the night?

title: Frequency of waking up
explanation: How often did you wake up during the night?

title: Duration of awake periods
explanation: How long were you awake in total during the night?

title: Medication
explanation: Did you take any medication (including long-term medication)?

title: Medication frequency
explanation: How often do you take this medication?

title: Caffeine or energy drinks
explanation: Did you consume coffee, energy drinks or other sugary or caffeinated beverages?

title: Screen time before sleep
explanation: How long was your screen time within 2 hours before going to sleep? (minutes)
